review.body:
<!-- factory-judge-review round=2 -->
### Factory judge · round 2 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — init.ts now calls writeBeside(..., false). The new test checks with --force that factory.yml is unchanged, factory.factory.yml equals the template, and no .bak exists. The updated existing test asserts the same.
- A2: met — The new test runs init with force false and true on an empty repo and asserts factory.yml is written from the template, with no sibling.
- A3: met — The new test asserts the output contains '.github/workflows/factory.yml exists; wrote .github/workflows/factory.factory.yml: merge it by hand'.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- An existing test was changed, so a person needs to sign it off `packages/cli/src/commands/init.test.ts:256` — None needed in code. Have a person sign off on the test change in the PR.
- The sibling sits in .github/workflows, so GitHub runs it as a live workflow if committed `packages/cli/src/commands/init.ts:505` — Ask `ignoreInFactory`/.gitignore to cover the sibling, or have `factory doctor` flag a committed `factory.factory.yml`, so the warning isn't the only guard.

</details>

_Not reviewed: `packages/action/dist/SOURCE_SHA256` (generated), `packages/action/dist/index.js` (generated)._

_claude-opus-5-5 · 1 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: An existing test was changed, so a person needs to sign it off
suggestions.detail: AGENTS.md lists 'tests that already exist' as a protected path, and its stop-and-ask list includes 'deleting or changing an existing test'. The old assertion (`factory.yml.bak` holds the old workflow, and `factory.yml` gets the template) contradicts A1, so changing it is needed and is not weakening a check. It is still a protected-path edit, so a person should approve it.
suggestions.repro: The diff edits the existing --force integration test at init.test.ts:253-261, replacing the factory.yml.bak expectation.
suggestions.fix: None needed in code. Have a person sign off on the test change in the PR.

suggestions.title: The sibling sits in .github/workflows, so GitHub runs it as a live workflow if committed
suggestions.detail: factory.factory.yml is the template, with the @v1 action, the template's job and check names, and the template gate. It is written into .github/workflows/, so if it is committed before it is merged and deleted, a second 'factory' workflow runs on PRs alongside the person's own. The added note warns about this, but the warning is the only safeguard.
suggestions.repro: Run `factory init --force` on a repo with a customised factory.yml, then `git add -A && git commit`. The PR runs both factory.yml and factory.factory.yml.
suggestions.fix: Ask `ignoreInFactory`/.gitignore to cover the sibling, or have `factory doctor` flag a committed `factory.factory.yml`, so the warning isn't the only guard.
